title: Three-line commitment cards — weekly check & micro-OKR notes
content:
Purpose: a compact weekly scratchpad using a 'three-line commitment card' method to keep micro-OKRs honest and behaviourally actionable. This is intentionally messy; notes to self, experiments, and quick retros.

Format (top of page):
- Week of: 2026-02-16 — 2026-02-22
- Three commitment cards (each = 1 daily micro-habit or single focused outcome)
- One signal metric (quantitative) + one vibe metric (qualitative)
- Quick obstacles / unblock actions (owner: me)

---
Week context: heavy on context-switching (oncall spike Tue); shipping small perf bits for embedding cache; aiming to move 2% token cost down for the prototype route.

Commitment card A — Low-latency smoke tests
- Aim: add a gated low-latency smoke test to CI that fails on 95th pct latency regressions > 20ms.
- Why: prevents small regressions from creeping into main.
- Implementation steps: add synthetic trace for seq_len 128, warmup of kv-cache; put on nightly; threshold set empirically (start 20ms, monitor 2w).
- Done? half: created test harness + synthetic traces, still tuning thresholds.

Commitment card B — Prompt set for quality guardrails
- Aim: finalize 25 prompt seeds for cost/quality regression checks for embedding/encode step.
- Why: Optimize batching + caching decisions without silently degrading embedding quality.
- Notes: 8 prompts annotated (good/ambiguous/bad); need cross-check with Eval team for edge cases.

Commitment card C — 15-minute daily cleanup
- Aim: clear inbox + triage backlog tickets; keep weekly WIP <= 5 items.
- Why: cognitive load, context switching hurts deep work.
- Done? Mixed — inbox down from 120 -> 60 but WIP still 7. Need stricter defs.

Signal metric (quantitative):
- Primary: end-to-end 95th percentile latency for "embed-route-proto" on dedicated test infra. Baseline 210ms -> goal 205ms by end of month (2.5% improvement).
- Secondary: tokens billed per 1k requests for sample workload.

Vibe metric (qualitative):
- Daily energy/responsiveness scale 1-5 (self). This week avg ~3.2 (oncall + late meetings).

Micro experiments / hypotheses:
- H1: Adding a tiny prefix cache for the first 16 tokens will reduce median tokens billed by ~1% for the demo flow. Experiment plan: run A/B on staging with 50/50 traffic 48h. Metric: billed tokens per request.
- H2: Prewarming long-lived worker pool during expected daytime hours reduces 95th latency spikes across concurrent bursts. Plan: synthetic load window testing.

Retrospective notes (this week):
- Win: got CI harness to catch a small dispatch path bug that previously slipped into canary. Saved ~0.6s in worst-case call.
- Friction: too many asynchronous todos; need better tiny-PR habit.
- Decision: enforce 1 small PR/day rule when not oncall; keeps review cycle moving.

Obstacles / blockers:
- ENV-keys rotation for staging (blocked experiments) — follow up w/ infra on 2026-02-18 (Sam).
- Need Eval tagging for 25 prompt seeds — create brief and assign to Amina by Fri.

Next week plan (3 actions):
1) Finalize thresholds on low-latency smoke tests and enable nightly gating (target: Mon 2026-02-23).
2) Complete remaining 17 prompt annotations + schedule 30m cross-check w/ Eval (target: Wed).
3) Run 48h A/B for prefix cache hypothesis (start Thurs).

Notes to self (quick heuristics):
- When energy < 3, only commit to 1 card that day.
- Use the 15-minute cleanup as real blocker: if not done, postpone deep work.
- Keep PRs < 200 lines for faster reviews.

Loose links (internal):
- Slack: #eng-weekly (pin: smoke-test-snippet), #eval (prompt-seeds thread)
- Jira: INF-342 (prefix-cache experiment), RUNTIME-211 (ci latency gate)

Open questions:
- Should the latency gate be strict failure or soft warning for first 2 weeks? Leaning soft -> monitor then fail. Rationale: avoid noisy rollbacks.
- Is 20ms the right threshold for 95th at seq_len 128? Might be too tight; gather 2w baseline.

Quick daily log (three-line per day — sample):
- Mon 2026-02-16: set up test harness; inbox purge 30m; energy 3.
- Tue 2026-02-17: oncall spike; reverted a rollback; little time for card B; energy 2.
- Wed 2026-02-18: tuned synthetic traces and ran first smoke; thresholds noisy; energy 3.5.

Archive / sign-offs:
- If smoke test stable for 14 days with <1% false positives, schedule to move from soft->hard fail.
- Cross-check prompt seeds with Amina; if flagged >15% degraded, revert caching decisions.

End of page — quick checkpoints:
- 1: follow up infra for ENV keys (Sam)
- 2: assign prompt tagging (Amina)
- 3: start A/B prefix cache Thurs.

(This doc intentionally short, scribbly. Use as week-of anchor and dumpboard for next-week grooming.)
